_comment: Schema for comms/claude_judgments/blind_grades.jsonl and comms/claude_judgments/revealed_grades.jsonl (CJ-3-BLIND-GRADE-PILOT; design docs/plans/ml-claude-distillation-DESIGN.md sections 3.1, 3.5.5, 4.3). APPEND-ONLY JSONL, one JSON object per line. CANONICAL SOURCE: trade_journal.db order_packages / trades, joined on `order_package_id` and `trade_id` (= trades.id). These files are a PROJECTION of Claude's judgement keyed to that source, never a copy of trade state: no price, P&L or outcome is stored here; the CJ-2 family (ml/datasets/families/claude_judgments.py) joins the outcome from the journal. What the grader was shown is reproducible from `packet_sha` + the run's committed packet file. A blind row's info_cutoff_at is the decision time (T0); a revealed row's is the trade's close (T1, label-only). Producer and validator: scripts/ops/blind_grade.py (`validate` runs in CI through tests/test_blind_grade.py::test_committed_stores_validate). Briefs: .claude/skills/performance-review/BLIND-GRADE-BRIEF.md and REVEAL-GRADE-BRIEF.md; prompt_sha is the git blob sha of the brief the grader read.

common_fields.trade_id: int, trades.id of the graded trade (join key)
common_fields.judged_at: ISO UTC, when the grader wrote the row
common_fields.info_cutoff_at: ISO UTC, the latest time of anything the grader was shown
common_fields.prompt_sha: str, git blob sha of the brief
common_fields.packet_sha: str, sha256 of the masked packet
common_fields.packet_id: str, the opaque BP- id the grader saw
common_fields.pre_cutoff: bool|null, decision time before the grader model's knowledge cutoff (null = unknown)

blind_fields.risk_management: enum (bracket placement; size is never shown)

revealed_fields.blind_judgment_id: str, the BG- row this revises
